OPENS Ch 23 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: wisdom-and-counsel theme. The chapter likely develops wisdom-and-counsel as Tewahedo-political-theology virtue. The wisdom-and-counsel-of-the-king theme parallels: PROVERBS 8:14-16 ('Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength. By me kings reign, and princes decree justice'); 1 KINGS 3:5-15 (Solomon's wisdom-prayer at Gibeon); 1 KINGS 4:29-34 (Solomon's wisdom-greater-than-all-the-children-of-the-east); 2 CHRONICLES 1:7-12 (the parallel); JOB 12:13-16 (with God is wisdom and strength); WISDOM OF SOLOMON 6-9 (the foundational royal-wisdom treatise); SIRACH 10:1-3 ('a wise judge will instruct his people'); ISAIAH 11:2 (Spirit-of-counsel + Spirit-of-might). Tewahedo political-theology preserves wisdom-and-counsel as one of the FOUR-CARDINAL-ROYAL-VIRTUES (paralleling Tewahedo-canonical Wisdom-of-Solomon canonicity). The Meqabyan chapter likely articulates wisdom-and-counsel grounded in the post-martyrdom moral-theology.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of FEAR-OF-THE-LORD as wisdom-foundation theme (paralleling 3 Mq 6:7 γ.4.8.D entry). The fear-of-the-LORD theme is the classic Wisdom-literature anchor: PROVERBS 1:7 + 9:10 ('the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom'); PSALM 111:10 (the same formula); SIRACH 1:11-30 (the fear-of-the-LORD catalog); ECCLESIASTES 12:13 ('fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man'); WISDOM OF SOLOMON 1:1-15 (the foundational royal-fear-of-God treatise); ACTS 9:31 (the church walking in fear-of-the-Lord and comfort-of-the-Holy-Ghost). Patristic-tradition: BARSANUPHIUS Letter 168 (monastic-fear-of-God as foundation — paired with 3 Mq 6:7 entry); JOHN CLIMACUS Ladder Step 1 (the renunciation-of-the-world rooted in fear-of-God). Tewahedo monastic-pedagogy explicitly grounds the spiritual-formation-rubric in fear-of-the-Lord as Step-Zero before complete-repentance (3 Mq 4:34 γ.4.8 seed).

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of WISDOM-IN-ACTION theme. The wisdom-in-action theme parallels: JAMES 1:22-25 ('be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only'); JAMES 2:14-26 (faith-without-works); JAMES 3:13-18 (wisdom-from-above as peaceable + gentle + full-of-mercy-and-good-fruits); MATTHEW 7:24-27 (the house-on-rock-vs-sand parable — wisdom-as-doing); LUKE 6:46-49 (the parallel-Lukan version); PROVERBS 14:8 ('the wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way'); ECCLESIASTES 8:1 ('a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine'). Tewahedo wisdom-tradition preserves wisdom-in-action as the DIAGNOSTIC-TEST OF GENUINE-WISDOM: contemplation-without-action is incomplete; speech-without-deed is hollow. The Meqabyan chapter likely synthesizes the wisdom-catalog into wisdom-actualization, preparing the chapter's transition to Ch 24's divine-justice / prophet-king confrontation.
